pages.text: Block radios draw energy (FE) every tick from the power network they are wired to, more while transmitting. Starved, a radio $(thing)browns out$(): its panel cycles on, PWR, dark.$(li)HF and all-band radio 8 / 26 FE/t$(li)QRP 2 / 13$(li)VHF base station 2 / 13$(li)Repeater 4 / 17$(li)Automatic tuner 4$(li)Microwave radio 26 while on

$(item)Solar panels$() join by touching each other and the $(item)charge controller$() at the end of the row. A controller passes up to 180 FE a tick, about 20 panels in full sun; for a bigger array, set more controllers against it, each wired to the batteries, and they share the panels' power. Run $(item)wire$() from the controller to a $(item)large battery$() and from the battery to the radio. The battery also takes and gives Forge Energy, so other mods' generators can charge it.
pages.title: Building it
Numbers
pages.text: A $(item)solar panel$() makes 9 FE/t by day under open sky, half that in rain. A $(item)large battery$() holds 260,000 FE, about a Minecraft day of a VHF base station; a $(item)small battery$() 60,000, and a new one comes half to two thirds charged.$(br2)Batteries wired together fill and drain together, each taking an even share.
